name: podgist-skill
description: Search, download, transcribe, analyze, and query podcast episodes with local Codex skills.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a podcast episode into a Chinese summary with timestamped listening recommendations.
interface.longDescription: Podgist Skill searches Apple podcast episodes, downloads a selected episode, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper, writes a Chinese analysis blog, and answers follow-up questions from saved artifacts.
interface.defaultPrompt: 帮我搜索一期播客，判断值不值得听，并给我能快速跳听的时间点。
